answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 706 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The tundra of the design is public, the shale of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the pulse of honest work is what finally pays.
